title: Mission 01: Lost Notes
story: Your first week at Hexworth Dynamics. A department's project report was split into fragments during a botched backup, the analyst's notes are gone, and the summary file is damaged. Rebuild it all. One tool will carry you through: cat.

badge.name: Lost Notes: Recovered
badge.desc: Mastered cat end to end by recovering a department's report from fragments.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING.txt in your department directory. Create ack.txt in the same directory containing exactly the code word it names, on a single line.

checks.fail: ack.txt does not exist in your department directory.
ack.txt exists but its content is not exactly the code word from BRIEFING.txt.
ack.txt should contain exactly one line.

tasks.brief: The analyst's notes are gone. Recreate notes.txt in your department directory with exactly these three lines, in order: 'Project: $MISSION_PROJ', 'Status: recovery in progress', 'Analyst: student'.

checks.fail: notes.txt does not exist yet.
Line 1 must be exactly: Project: <your project name>.
Line 2 must be exactly: Status: recovery in progress
Line 3 must be exactly: Analyst: student

tasks.brief: Append two MORE lines to notes.txt without disturbing the first three: 'Fragments: located' then 'Merge: pending'. The file must end up with exactly five lines.

checks.fail: notes.txt must contain exactly five lines (three originals plus the two appended).
The first three lines changed. Append, do not overwrite.
Line 4 must be exactly: Fragments: located
Line 5 must be exactly: Merge: pending

tasks.brief: The report was split into part1.txt, part2.txt and part3.txt inside the fragments/ directory. Merge them IN ORDER into report_combined.txt in your department directory.

checks.fail: report_combined.txt does not exist yet.
report_combined.txt exists but is not the three fragments joined in order (check the order, and do not add or remove anything).

tasks.brief: Compliance wants a line-numbered copy of the combined report. Produce numbered.txt: every line numbered, exactly as cat's own numbering renders it.

checks.fail: numbered.txt does not exist yet.
numbered.txt does not match cat's line numbering of report_combined.txt (hint: there is a cat option that does this in one step).

tasks.brief: Legal disagrees: blank lines must NOT be numbered. Produce nonblank.txt, numbering only the non-blank lines of the combined report.

checks.fail: nonblank.txt does not exist yet.
nonblank.txt does not match cat's non-blank numbering of report_combined.txt (a different cat option than the last task).

tasks.brief: messy.txt looks fine but breaks the import tool: it hides tabs and trailing whitespace. Produce visible.txt showing ALL invisible characters (tabs, line ends, everything), exactly as cat renders them.

checks.fail: visible.txt does not exist yet.
visible.txt does not match cat's show-all rendering of messy.txt (tabs should appear as ^I and line ends as $).

tasks.brief: The import vendor only needs to see line endings, not tabs. Produce ends.txt from messy.txt with just end-of-line markers shown.

checks.fail: ends.txt does not exist yet.
ends.txt does not match cat's end-of-line rendering of messy.txt (line ends as $, tabs left alone).

tasks.brief: Take a dictation the old-school way: create dictation.txt containing the single line 'Recovered by hand for project $MISSION_PROJ' by typing it into cat reading from your keyboard (standard input).

checks.fail: dictation.txt does not exist yet.

checks.cmd: grep -qx "Recovered by hand for project $MISSION_PROJ" /home/student/$MISSION_DEPT/dictation.txt && test "$(wc -l < /home/student/$MISSION_DEPT/dictation.txt)" -eq 1
checks.fail: dictation.txt must contain exactly that one line, nothing else.

tasks.brief: Build memo.txt: a header line 'MEMO: $MISSION_DEPT recovery' typed from standard input, followed immediately by the full contents of notes.txt. One command can weave stdin and a file together.

checks.fail: memo.txt does not exist yet.
Line 1 of memo.txt must be the exact MEMO header.
Everything after the header must be exactly the current contents of notes.txt.

tasks.brief: Somewhere in the three fragments hides one line mentioning the code word. Pipe the fragments through a search and save that single line to found.txt.

checks.fail: found.txt does not exist yet.
found.txt must contain exactly the one fragment line that mentions the code word, and nothing else.

tasks.brief: Assemble FINAL_REPORT.txt for the director: HEADER.txt, then the combined report, then FOOTER.txt, joined in that order.

checks.fail: FINAL_REPORT.txt does not exist yet.
FINAL_REPORT.txt is not HEADER + combined report + FOOTER in exact order.
A professional leaves no junk behind.

tasks.brief: BONUS: the director jokes she reads reports bottom-up. Produce reversed.txt: the combined report with its line order flipped. cat has a mirror-image cousin.

checks.fail: reversed.txt must be report_combined.txt with line order exactly reversed.
